summary: Preserve FP32 router weights in fused W4A16 prefill reduction
compatibility: No user action required. Both precision and fused-prefill options remain disabled by default.
details: When B12X_W4A16_FP32_TOPK_WEIGHTS=1 and B12X_W4A16_PREFILL_FUSED_SUM=1, the FC2 epilogue applies FP32 router weights before accumulating expert outputs. Prepared capacities, mapped experts, logical tails, and allocation-stable CUDA graph replay retain the same semantics.
